# dsh-local-model
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the model start, stop, and inspect local inference servers — Str
ata, Ollama, llama.cpp, or anything else that answers an OpenAI-compatible model listing.
The agent asks for a server by name and gets back `provider/model` references it can select on the m
odel route that fronts that server. No shell script in the middle, no per-machine hardcoding in the
plugin: the servers are deployment configuration.

## Install
Not on npm yet. Vendor it into a harness checkout or link it from a profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then mount the built package by absolute path, or `pnpm link` it into the harness that will load it.
A `file:` dependency copies the package into the profile's `node_modules`; after editing sources, re
build and copy `lib/` plus `client/` there again, or reinstall the profile.
## Configure
Declare the servers this composition may start. `command`, `args`, and `cwd` go to the subprocess pr
ovider verbatim — no shell, so anything shell-shaped has to be spelled out.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Meaning |

| `command` | executable name or absolute path |
| `args` | arguments, passed verbatim |
| `cwd` | w

orking directory for the child process |
| `env` | extra environment entries, merged onto the provid

er's environment |
| `port` | the port the server listens on |
| `provider` | route name in `provide

r/model` refs; defaults to the config key |
| `modelsPath` | HTTP path answering the model list; def
aults to `/v1/models` |
An empty `servers` table is valid: the tool is registered with nothing to start.
## Actions
| `action` | Behaviour |

| `list` | only servers that are answering |
| `status` | every configured server, answering or not

|
| `start` | spawn if down, then wait until the model listing answers; idempotent when already up;

terminates the child if the budget runs out; `server: "all"` starts every configured server |
| `sto
p` | terminate, wait for exit — only for servers **this plugin** started; `server: "all"` stops ever

y server it owns |
| `toggle` | flip one server: stop it when it answers, start it when it is down;
without a name it acts on `default` |
Starting a server stops the others this plugin owns, because `exclusive` defaults to true: two local
engines usually compete for the same device memory. Set `exclusive: false` to keep several resident
usually compete for the same device memory. Set `exclusive: false` to keep several resident at once.
Readiness is one HTTP `GET <modelsPath>`: a server counts as up when it lists at least one model. Th
at rule works for OpenAI-compatible servers and for Ollama-shaped listings (`data[].id` or `models[]
works for OpenAI-compatible servers and for Ollama-shaped listings (`data[].id` or `models[].name`).
## Slash command
`/local-model [status | list | start [server|all] | stop [server|all] | toggle [server] | diag <text
>]` — the same actions from the composer. `diag` appends a timestamped line to `~/.dsh/local-model/c
ctions from the composer. `diag` appends a timestamped line to `~/.dsh/local-model/client-diag.log`.
## Composer control and shortcut
The client half registers two 11px chips in `conversation.composer.dock`: `本地模型` toggles the `defaul
t` server only, `▾` opens a 272px panel with `状态`, one `● name` / `○ name` chip per configured serve
r, one `用 <provider/model>` button per advertised ref, and the last result text. The panel only exis
ts while open, so the dock row keeps its normal width; status text also lands in the transcript thro
ugh the host command output.
`Ctrl+Shift+L` (`Cmd+Shift+L` on macOS) runs the same toggle from anywhere in the page. Defaults are
bound per platform profile in `SHORTCUT_DEFAULTS`, so rebinding goes through the harness shortcut s
er platform profile in `SHORTCUT_DEFAULTS`, so rebinding goes through the harness shortcut settings.
## What this plugin does not do
It owns process lifecycle, not routing. To actually send a model request to a server it started, add
an LLM adapter route whose `baseURL` is that server's port — for example an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-p
route whose `baseURL` is that server's port — for example an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` provider:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`refs` in the result gives exactly the `provider/model` spelling to select there.
## Design notes
- **No new capability seam.** This is a Consumer over the existing `subprocess` capability; a second

service definition would have no second consumer.
- **Termination is process-tree-wide**, because i
t goes through the same subprocess provider the rest of the harness uses — a killed server leaves no

orphan worker processes.
- **No KV-cache churn.** The tool description and parameter schema are fix

ed text; nothing here changes between turns.
- **Ownership is enforced, not assumed.** `stop` refuse
s a server that answers on the port but was started elsewhere, rather than killing a process the plu
wers on the port but was started elsewhere, rather than killing a process the plugin did not create.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The subprocess provider is faked in tests at the seam's shape, so the shipping plugin body runs unmo
dified against a real `ToolRuntime` and a real HTTP listener.
